news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Consensys to split into MetaMask and institutional blockchain company
news.summary: The restructuring will separate MetaMask’s consumer business from Consensys’ Ethereum protocols and institutional blockchain infrastructure operations.

news.title: Bitcoin fails to reclaim $80K as Bessent fuels yen strength around 153 per dollar
news.summary: Bitcoin trended lower with US stocks on Iran escalation while US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent contributed to fears of a yen carry-trade unwind.

news.title: Tether pushes into private credit with $400 million fund with Fasanara
news.summary: The USDT issuer will help source lending opportunities and provide stablecoin payment infrastructure for Fasanara's private credit network.

news.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum race quantum clock as U.S. backs $300 million hardware push
news.summary: The threat is not here yet, but fault-tolerant machines and crypto’s migration plans are starting to converge on the same 2029 window.

news.title: Consensys to split MetaMask into its own firm while staying silent on IPO
news.summary: The existing company, Consensys Software Inc., will rebrand as MetaMask under Ethereum co-founder Joe Lubin as chairman and CEO.

news.title: Tether, Fasanara launch $400M private credit fund targeting $3B
news.summary: The evergreen fund will use USDT infrastructure to support asset-backed lending through fintech platforms in more than 60 countries.

news.title: Germany moves to tax bitcoin like stocks as new draft bill targets tax-free gains
news.summary: Existing holdings would keep the current tax treatment, which can allow tax-free sales after a 12-month holding period.

news.title: Bitcoin climbs as oil tops $100, equities drop after Iran strikes
news.summary: Bitcoin advanced to as high as $79,700 while Brent crude topped $100 and European shares fell, leaving crypto tracking gold rather than equities.

news.title: Bitcoin SOPR metric sees longest profit run of 2026 as new analysis challenges bear market
news.summary: Bitcoin aggregate onchain profit entered its fourth week, but a popular analyst warned that BTC price “downside risk” remained in place.

news.title: Singaporean 22-year old pleads guilty to being the ringleader in $245 million crypto fraud case
news.summary: Malone Lam, a Miami resident charged with stealing 4,100 bitcoin, led a ring of fraudsters who stole crypto via online scams and home invasions.

news.title: ストラテジー、ビットコイン柄ジョーダン即完売　決済は仮想通貨非対応
news.summary: ストラテジーが250ドルのBTC柄ナイキ製ジョーダンを自社ストアで発売し即完売した。決済はカード・Apple Payのみでビットコイン非対応のため、海外の仮想通貨コミュニティから皮肉交じりの批判が相次いでいる。

news.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block seeks US trust bank charter for Bitcoin, stablecoin
news.summary: The proposed Builders Bank would offer federally supervised digital asset custody but would not accept deposits or issue loans.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips as yields head higher following Treasury buyback announcement
news.summary: The Japanese yen extended its rally against the greenback, briefly strengthening past 153 per dollar.

news.title: Bitcoin recovers toward $79,000 as Zcash records a $500 million ETF haul
news.summary: Bitcoin fell to nearly $77,600 on Tuesday before clawing most of it back, leaving it little changed on the day while zcash gained roughly 43% on the week and Grayscale's new fund crossed half a billion dollars.

news.title: ビットコイン、7.9万ドル圏で横ばい　強弱材料で拮抗＝グラスノード
news.summary: グラスノードの週次レポートによると、ビットコインは7.9万ドル圏で横ばい推移。現物モメンタムは急減速する一方、先物・オプション建玉は拡大し、オプション市場ではコール需要優勢で上値を意識したポジショニングが鮮明になった。

news.title: ジャック・ドーシー率いるブロック、米信託銀行設立を申請
news.summary: 米フィンテック大手ブロックが、ビットコインやステーブルコインのカストディ業務を担う信託銀行「ビルダーズバンク」設立をOCCに申請した。認可されれば、ビットコイン・ステーブルコイン関連業務に連邦レベルの監督枠組みが加わることになる。

news.title: New York town weighs crypto mining and AI data center ban
news.summary: One of the first towns in the US to ban Bitcoin mining for 18 months is considering another temporary moratorium extending to data centers and other crypto mining operations.

news.title: Franklin Templeton digital asset veteran takes helm at StablecoinX
news.summary: Former Franklin Templeton digital asset executive Christopher Jensen will lead StablecoinX, the largest corporate holder of Ethena’s ENA token.

news.title: Bitcoin faces key support test at $78.3K as US crude oil hits three-month high
news.summary: Bitcoin fell with US stocks on the opening of Tuesday’s Wall Street trading session as analysis warns that BTC price support at $78,300 must hold.

news.title: Bitmine buys 28k ETH, completes 97% of treasury accumulation goal
news.summary: While Bitmine’s completed 97% of its goal to acquire 5% of Ether’s supply, Tom Lee’s team faces a $5.1 billion unrealized loss on its main treasury asset.

news.title: Is Bitcoin too volatile to risk your retirement on?
news.summary: Bitcoin believers see it as an almost certain long-term investment, but retirement demands a different approach. How much crypto exposure is too much for your retirement account?

news.title: Strategy skips Bitcoin buy to repurchase $176M of STRC preferred shares
news.summary: Strategy repurchased $176 million worth of its STRC preferred stock and doubled the size of its digital securities repurchase program to $2 billion, while pausing on new Bitcoin buys.
